learning.rule: Repeated gross/gas failures suspend an asset cluster until new positive known-net observations reopen it. One sentinel quote per collection keeps suspensions reversible. Only >=3 measured observations with positive known net admit a new hypothesis. These are training filters, not forward performance.

previousEpochHypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both entry thresholds, or if any eligible quote fails the configured route/size checks. Do not interpret passing the screen as acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation gate; unknown extra gas, infrastructure, and model invoice costs remain excluded from any full-profit claim.
previousEpochHypotheses.name: wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
previousEpochHypotheses.rationale: Hypothesis needing fresh quotes: this WETH → USDG → PONS → wPONS → WETH route could show size-dependent net quote behavior across its supplied exact sizes. SIZE_CURVE must quote every supplied exact size up to 0.005 WETH and select the greatest current after-gas net; it must not scale outputs. Enter only when the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the 15000 bps gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations. The supplied training data does not validate this forward hypothesis.

selection.policy: At most the latest 80 unseen frames per six-hour decision; other frames remain in published sources and never become forward evidence for this decision. Available menu is a deterministic 128-cell subset, not a complete market search.
